content: 3:1-4 In Munon inubersiau tari nob bo der bugaminei
An Munon inubersiau tari nob igomot der bugaman end Qenu wonou ginamt qomon end qas qoot igoarar. Ginam end Munon inubersiau tari wo Munon baraitari aib Qenu uberegent wes end igo.
Aninou misir eng Qenu ginamt mi igo eng gub qamb qoot igoarar. Mi ag e gub qamb qoot me at igoarar.
An umumon end aninou igom eng Munon inubersiau tari nob waber Qenu qani igo.
Munon inubersiau tari wo in igomot igamau qanam eng. Qen geret wo dibenara an nob dibent wonou begen eng anit isa an wonou qiribiten end igoruboumon.
3:5-11 Munon bubun dariaminei

End ne ai qen e wonou qomon boru an misirt igo eng gugum mogirt wab wagar. Qomon boru ete end quraum: yamangar qiyo munon song-song nob qib qiyo, a qomon boru qei, a mi gab oau naget qiyo, a munon ger wonou mi gab qenunget abau eng ai bigau wurit oabigau gas ende gari.
Munon qomon eng qas toat igorunor eng Qenu wurit misiringet wurigumutumaimba.
Qoan aninou munon yurau eng wurinob qib qomon eng gugum at igumanei.
Ego see an qomon eng gagar gugum wagar: misiringet oau biriberi nub, a munon ger siningot, a mindigar qob qamb, a qob isi qamb, qomon eng gagar.
An git goan qoan ninir-neri wogub bo bubun buraman end munon banam qimurimar me qamarar. Qenu munon bubun eng barsier end anseara wonou qomon uber musub imbig ne wonou iitari mom buruboumon.

End qomon bubun eng, munon yurau ar qiyo, a Yuda qiyo, a munon git goan mari nob qiyo, a mari ue qiyo, a qob wes-wes ne munon wes-wes, ne wau unebi qiyo, a munon unum diban qiyo, eng gagar gugum ue. Munon inubersiau tari wonou gari igo mi eng gagar aba qeemben gari igour, ger wuritanami erer me igo. Wonou gari wuriboopuri ten igo.
3:12-17 In munon qei apand wuriqenungar igorun

Qenu wonou an qenungar ne wonou munon yurau anqereiamorei. End ne an qomon ete abar: munon gugum wurit igub wurimusiarar. Aninomi bumai wogub munon qei qomon mein eng wuriimbigar. Ne munon qei ansumungasiari ibag wagari ende ansiorunor.

Aninou munon banam ger wonou munon yurau end der mindigar qob ger wot qamb igamari eng wuri qi igamari wurinou qomon boru eng wurit dibes qemeriner. Munon aib aninou qomon boru anit birogoniamor end an bo imusi munon qei ende wurisiarar.
Qitoubau qomon eng qomon gugum wuritanami ne qomon uber qei wuriqubei igo. Ende ebet ne qomon qei gor erogori aba dibent uber igour.

Munon inubersiau tari wo in munon qomon paparau boru eng meinsi igo. Qomon mein eng aninou misir end mom igama toat igoarar. Igamari Qenu anit ara an git goan gari burab oau mein end igoruboumon. End Qenut qenen wot uber qamb igoarar.

Munon inubersiau wonou qob uber eng qenen abari aninou oau end yabri iua igoriner. Igama an misir uber igub aninou munon banam qomon uber end wuriimbigar. Aninou misir end Qenut uber qamb ne buk Sam qob end qiyo uru uber qei-qei wab aninou igom meriri eng abari nonoguret igoriner.
Qob qamb qiyo, sarau ebet gab eng Munon Aib Yisas unumut qas abar. Wo gab-gab Qenu ininou Tain wot uber qamarar.
3:18-21 Ininou yurau tetemi musub wurinob igorun
An yamangar, aninou munon wuri ii igoarar. Qomon eng Munon Aib magqurt qoregen.
An munon, aninou yamangar wuriqenungar ne wurimusiarar. Wuritumar abari wuri oau me quguragetorunor.
An wau, aninou tain nanib qob qamarari igatar toat mi qomorunor eng abar. Ende abari Munon Aib anqenungariba.
An wau ur unor, aninou wau me wurisesimoarar. Ende wurisearari wuri bo ietorubour.
3:22-4:1 Pol munon baraitari ne munon soro ar eng wuri irun wab qamarei
An wau unebi, aninou munon barai qob qamara igetet mi gugum qemeriner eng toat abar. Wo magqurt qas sarau ubune qen inimbegeiner qamb me abar. An Munon Aibt igub aninou misirt sarau qoregen abar.
Mi gugum ebet eng qeretutnob abar. Munangit sarau obotoroun ende misir igub me abar, ue. Munon Aib sarau obotoun ende qamb abar.
Ende obounon eng qen geret sarau uber eng taui Munon Aib mi andarib qamb anit iyeter eng igo. An Munon inubersiau tari wonou sarau munon igoarar, wo aninou Munon aib.
Munon ger qomon soagen ebeiner eng taui qamb Qenu seara boruburiba. Qenu munon gugum qeemben qereimba. Munon ger aib qamb qiyo ger boru qamb ende me wanungereminerei.
